title.narrative: Enhanced Emergency Response for Assisting Drought-Affected Communities in the Somali Region

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtIn response to the unfolding humanitarian crisis in the Somali Region, particularly within the Sitti zone of Geblalu Woreda, Welthungerhilfe (WHH) is leading a collaborative effort alongside Action for the Needy in Ethiopia (ANE). With WHH's demonstrated success in project implementation, including a recent multi-sectoral initiative valued at 1 million USD funded by EHF/OCHA in Geblalu Woreda, coupled with ANE's invaluable local expertise, our consortium is uniquely positioned to address the pressing needs of affected communities. Notably, WHH recently concluded a similar 1 million USD EHF-funded multisectoral project in Filtu Woreda of the Somali region.ltbrgtThis proposed project aims to confront the complex challenges faced by vulnerable populations, including the severe impact of drought, conflict, flooding, and escalating food insecurity. Drawing on our extensive experience in the zone, WHH and ANE will prioritize critical sectors such as Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH), Emergency Agriculture-livestock health and restocking and Nutrition .ltbrgtWHH's commitment to localized aid is reinforced by our collaboration with ANE, ensuring that interventions are community-driven, culturally sensitive, and sustainable. By empowering local partners and building upon existing resilience programs, WHH aims to maximize the impact of humanitarian assistance and foster long-term resilience within affected communities.ltbrgtThe humanitarian crisis in the Somali Region, particularly in the Sitti zone of Geblalu Woreda, is characterized by widespread food insecurity, malnutrition, and limited access to essential health, WASH and livestock health services. The convergence of drought, flooding, and economic instability has further amplified the vulnerability of already marginalized more than 1000 IDP populations, necessitating urgent life-saving support.ltbrgtIn response, the project will prioritize the delivery of emergency WASH, emergency livelihood support - livestock health and restocking, health and nutrition services to mitigate the immediate impacts of the crisis. ltbrgtWHH -ANE will closely work with the agency OWS-DF to address the health needs of the community . Additionally, WHH and ANE will collaboratively address underlying vulnerabilities and build community resilience to withstand future shocks.ltbrgtWith a robust foundation of local partnerships, expertise, and a comprehensive approach to addressing the humanitarian crisis, WHH and ANE are poised to make a meaningful difference in the lives of more than 22,000 people those affected by the crisis in Geblalu Woreda. Support from EHF/OCHA will enable the WHH-led initiative to deliver vital assistance, promote sustainable development, and restore hope to communities in need. Securing the requested funding will allow the WHH led initiative to make a lasting impact and ensure that no one is left behind in their time of greatest need.ltbrgtlt/pgt
